subject: Request: Sprint Allocation & Contract Condition for VeloxBank Fraud-Detection Pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ribeiro <sofia.ribeiro@veloxbank.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@veloxbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Sprint Allocation & Contract Condition for VeloxBank Fraud-Detection Pilot

Team — attaching the mutual action plan (draft) and the MAP spreadsheet for context. VeloxBank (Sofia/Miguel) is asking for an ability we do not currently expose in the Console: per-tenant adaptive anomaly thresholds and a simple rule toggle that can be applied at tenant scope without a full model change. They want this for the fraud-detection pilot: ability to set a separate threshold and a 3rd-party webhook routing rule per tenant so they can tune sensitivity per business line.

Why this is urgent: Velox has committed to a pilot go-live on 2026-09-20 as a condition for the seed contract (VELX-2421). If we cannot demonstrate per-tenant thresholding and a configurable webhook rule in the pilot, they have indicated they will request a credits/discount concession. ARR upside for full rollout is estimated at $720k ARR.

What I'm asking of Product/Eng: please review the scope below and let us know whether we can (A) deliver a config-only MVP that wires up Console + routing flags (no model retraining) within a 3-week sprint, or (B) need runtime/serving changes that would push to multiple sprints.

MVP scope (proposed):
- Console toggle at tenant level to set anomaly threshold (float, 0.0-1.0)
- Routing flag to send alerts to tenant-specific webhook endpoint
- Audit log entry for any threshold change (for compliance)
- Acceptance test harness: synthetic traffic + 3-day soak

Acceptance criteria (for contract):
1) Endpoint to set tenant threshold and webhook exists and is documented
2) Console UI exposes toggle and persists to tenant config
3) Changes are reflected in routing within 5 minutes of update
4) MAP sign-off from Velox pilot team after 3-day smoke tests

Attachments: Velox_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (MAP), MAP-veloxbank.xlsx (timeline + milestones).

Asks / next steps:
- Product/Eng: feasibility + rough ETA by EOD tomorrow (2026-08-10)
- If feasible: commit a sprint slot and list of owners; Sales will backfill contract language and pilot credits.

Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ribeiro <sofia.ribeiro@veloxbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sprint Allocation & Contract Condition for VeloxBank Fraud-Detection Pilot

Thanks Chloe — quick technical read: promising ask, and definitely preferable to avoid touching model weights. A few clarifying questions before we can give a sprint estimate (we can probably scope an MVP to 1–3 sprints depending on answers):

1) Is the threshold intended to be an input to our serving runtime decision (i.e., gating alerts before they leave the runtime), or is it a post-processing filter in the alerting pipeline? If the former, that means changes to the runtime's decision path and KV cache invalidation; if the latter, it is primarily a small orchestration/config change.

2) For audit logs, is Velox requiring a tamper-evident/immutable log (e.g., exportable for SOC2), or will our standard audit entries suffice?

3) What are expected traffic characteristics for the pilot (TPS peaks, avg seq length)? That drives whether the new routing path will affect latency SLOs.

Preliminary technical take: if we implement thresholding as a post-runtime filter (config + webhook routing) and expose tenant config in the Console and API, we can likely deliver a config-only MVP within a single 3-week sprint with 1 engineer + 0.5 QE focused effort, plus a lightweight rollout plan (canary by account). If the threshold must be evaluated in the runtime hot path, this becomes ~3 engineer-weeks and needs kernel/runtime changes (risk to latency SLOs).

Please provide answers to the three points and the synthetic traffic numbers; I'll draft a minimal technical spec and estimate.

—Jordan
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ribeiro <sofia.ribeiro@veloxbank.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@veloxbank.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sprint Allocation & Contract Condition for VeloxBank Fraud-Detection Pilot

Looping in Karthik as PM — Velox is an Enterprise strategic target for Q4 and the ask is directly tied to the signed pilot MOU. Upside is material and the customer has limited appetite to wait beyond the pilot date. If Product can ship a config-only approach, Sales will finalize a pilot commitment that includes: 3 months dedicated capacity at a discounted rate and an explicit statement in the MAP that we deliver the tenant-config feature prior to go-live.

If Product wants to reduce scope to de-risk and meet the timeline: we are comfortable paring back the UI to a single toggle + API and delaying any advanced audit/immutable log features to R2. That trade gives us a path to ship in sprint T+1.

Karthik — please advise whether you can accept the config-only MVP trade and if Product can slot this into the next sprint planning (starts 2026-08-17). If not, we need an explicit list of blocking items so Sales can adjust contractual language with Velox.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

- If Product confirms slot for sprint starting 2026-08-17, Sales will finalize the pilot addendum and sign the MAP; Velox will provide test accounts and sample traffic (Sofia, Miguel — can you confirm sample dataset availability by 2026-08-13?).

Proposed immediate actions:
